part2_first_line: Key at first asked me innocently, "Can you be my guru?" I told her, “I’m not anyone's guru, but we can learn from each other.” A few months later, she was telling me she was much more spiritually advanced than me. I asked, “Do you recall asking me to be your guru?” She said, "Wow, I must have been really confused back then!"
